title: Maximum number of supported packet filters

entities.name: Maximum number of supported packet filters
entities.description: Information element indicating the maximum number of packet filters supported by the UE for a PDU session.

entities.name: PDU session type
entities.description: Property defining the type of PDU session, which can be IPv4, IPv6, IPv4v6, or Ethernet.

entities.name: PDU session type condition
entities.description: Condition that the selected PDU session type must be IPv4, IPv6, IPv4v6, or Ethernet.

entities.name: UE packet filter support condition
entities.description: Condition that the UE can support more than 16 packet filters for the PDU session.

relations.description: The inclusion of the IE is guarded by the PDU session type condition.
The inclusion of the IE is guarded by the UE packet filter support condition.
